verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists "Auditability (audit log and API)" as a product feature, and an incident responder independently reports analyzing TeamViewer connection logs, so a first-party connection/audit log does exist. The evidence is only a one-line feature bullet, with no detail on log contents or export. Missing for 10: documented fields showing who connected to which device and when, a documented export format or audit-export workflow (CSV/API endpoint details), and plan/tier scoping of the audit log.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit
